description: This header file defines an abstract class 'CredentialSource' and functions to obtain different types of credential sources, primarily for authentication purposes in the android-cuttlefish project. It declares APIs for credential management, including OAuth token refresh and retrieval mechanisms.

classes.name: CredentialSource
classes.description: An abstract class representing a source of credentials, with a method to retrieve credentials as a string.

methods.name: CredentialSource::Credential
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the credential as a string.

methods.name: GetCredentialSource
methods.description: Factory function to create a credential source based on various input parameters such as HTTP client and file paths.

methods.name: CreateRefreshTokenCredentialSource
methods.description: Factory function to create a credential source using OAuth refresh tokens.

calls: GetCredentialSource(http_client, credential_source, oauth_filepath, use_gce_metadata, credential_filepath, service_account_filepath)
